title: Zodiac 2021 (Year of the Ox) Postage Stamp

detail_fields.Issue Name: Zodiac 2021 (Year of the Ox) Postage Stamp
detail_fields.Details: The Generous Cow with Plentiful Wealth H.R.H. Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn has bestowed upon Thailand Post with a aeries of Royal Illustrations. Since initiating in 2015, in the Year of the Goat, her hand-drawn Zodiac stamps will run consecutively for the next 12 years. The Year of the Ox is 7th stamp in the series. When we think of an ox, we often think of their nutritional benefits such as their meat and milk. In agriculture, they are an indispensable part of the Thai way of life since ancient time. Hindus also believe that cow are sacred and a symbol of good luck. The stamp contains a signed illustration of an ox fishing by H.R.H. Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn, with a short message that reads, 'The Ox catches the fish. Money will be plentiful'. Design: Illustrating the zodiac sign for the year of the ox. The ox drawing is the royal hand sketch by Her Royal Highness Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn. Quantity of stamps: 1,000,000 pieces Sheet Composition: 10 stamps per sheet Printing Process: Lithography, Multi-colour Designer: Mr. Udorn Niyomtham (Thailand Post Co., Ltd.) FDC Price: 12 Baht FDC Quantity: -- covers
detail_fields.Size: 30 x 40.5 mm. (Vertical-measured from perforation to perforation)
